notes: The rarer the hero, the crazier the ultimate. Legendary: cinema bars and camera punches. Demigod: a charge-up and black-and-white impact frames. Olympian: Olympus opens over the whole game window, a golden pillar of light slams down, the screen tilts and splits colour. Primordial: the whole game is pulled into a cosmic void, the screen cracks, a black hole, a supernova, enemies float off the ground, the screen shatters. New sounds for the big moments.
